posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Greywind:

More pertinently, I'm playing Tachyon. Tachyon does 2 damage at this point. BHMeerkat is taking care of Cosmo.

It seems kind of a dangerous precedent to include half the effects on the board which are modifying damage, but leave the person who controls the target to keep track of the other half.  I figure that on one's own turn, one should either calculate all the modifiers or only the base damage, but not try to split the difference.

Also, Tachyon was at 18 HP on her last turn, and was shot for 6 by a Drone, so she should be at 12; Meerkat's Omnitron post is showing her at 14.

Warlock, the Explosives Wagon is gone, so unless I'm missing something Wraith deals 5 damage with Razor Ordnance and 1 with Last Stand, leaving COT with 71.

Unless things radically change during Expat and Haka's turns, my plan is to plunk down Upgrade Mode and then External Combustion.  I could put down Ammo Drop instead if Tachyon will be able to kill one or both Drones.
